Value by confidence band

High 70+ · Medium 40-69 · Low 1-39 · None 0

WFP price per kg against Comext

COMEXT rows with a Comext kg/unit, EUR per kg, log scales. Outside the shaded 0.2-5x band is flagged. Click a point to open the row.

Production emissions by manufacturing category

t CO2e, cradle-to-gate. Weight-based = kg x composite BEIS / ADEME material factor; spend-based = OpenCEDA by supplier country.

Weight-based against spend-based

Weight-based rows: both methods in t CO2e, by item, top 12 by weight-based emissions. Bars far apart point to a recipe, weight or sector to check.

Where the estimated weight sits

Total estimated tonnes by item, top 12. A bar that looks too long is the first place to look.

Consistency checks

Integrity checks test the outputs against the toolkit's own rules and must be zero. Review checks point at rows to look at. Select a check to see its rows.

Where production emissions come from

Tile area = t CO2e. Select a tile to open it; use the trail to go back. Weight-based items split into their recipe components (item kg x mass share x material factor); spend-based items show their OpenCEDA sector.

Consistency within items

One row per item. A wide range of price per kg inside one item means some rows have the wrong quantity unit, the wrong weight, or belong to another item. Select an item to see its rows.
